product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount for Back-to-Back Landscape Displays Fits 43 to 86 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount for Back-to-Back Landscape Displays, Fits 43-86in TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount is a professional ceiling-suspension solution designed to mount two large displays back-to-back from a single ceiling drop. It supports 43" to 86" landscape displays, delivering controlled tilt, swivel, and rotation for clean, high-visibility installs in retail, transportation, and public venues where content must be seen from opposite directions.Dual-interface design supports two landscape displays mounted back-to-back from one ceiling dropEach display supports up to 110 lb (50 kg)Compatible with VESA mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400Telescoping pole provides adjustable drop of approximately 51.4" to 74.9"Post-installation swivel (±60°), tilt (-20° to +5°), level (±3°), and rotation (±180°) adjustmentSteel construction for indoor commercial use with professional installation requiredCompliant with REACH, EU POP, TSCA 6(h), and California Prop 65Ideal for airports, malls, and wayfinding signage BACK-TO-BACK DUAL-DISPLAY CONFIGURATIONThe dual-interface design supports two landscape displays mounted back-to-back, enabling content visibility from both sides of a walkway or open space. Each display mounts independently to the central pole assembly. SUPPORTS LARGE COMMERCIAL DISPLAYSEach display supports up to 110 lb (50 kg), allowing use with large-format commercial panels within the supported size range. Load ratings are defined in the approved specification and user manual. WIDE VESA COMPATIBILITYCompatible with VESA® mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400, covering the majority of 43"-86" flat or curved landscape displays used in signage and corporate environments. LONG-POLE DROP FOR HIGH CEILINGSThe telescoping pole provides an adjustable ceiling-to-display drop range of approximately 51.4" to 74.9" (1305-1905 mm ±15 mm), allowing alignment with sightlines in large open interiors. POST-INSTALLATION ALIGNMENT CONTROLSwivel: ±60°. Tilt: -20° to +5°. Level adjustment: ±3°. Rotation: ±180°. These adjustments allow correction for ceiling irregularities and precise alignment without removing the displays. COMMERCIAL INDOOR CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction is intended for indoor commercial use only. Professional installation and routine safety inspections are required per the safety guidelines. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Ceiling mounting plate• Telescoping steel pole assembly• Dual display mounting rails and brackets• Complete mounting hardware kit• Installation manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
